recap.headline: Harbour began by dominating through an aggressive high press and central overload; Kestrel reversed the game after half-time by crowding the centre, dropping Harbour's high wins and taking more possession to level.

first_half.text: Harbour pressed very high and generated lots of high recoveries and central entries, creating the bulk of the danger and two goals.
Kestrel were pinned back in possession and produced fewer shots and low expected goals while struggling to win the ball high.
The field tilt and Harbour final-third dominance show the first-half structure: Harbour operated centrally and enjoyed a strong share of final-third possession.

changes.text: Kestrel tightened the middle and pushed play more into Harbour's half, increasing their possession and final-third entries.
Harbour's centre overload was substantially reduced after the break as Kestrel crowded the middle, cutting Harbour's centre entries and their high recoveries.
Harbour shifted some attacking weight toward the left but saw fewer shots and lower xG in the second half as their pressing intensity eased slightly and turnovers happened deeper.

predictions.text: Harbour will change where they attack to avoid predictability, increasing right-side final-third entries.
Kavanagh will accept a slightly lower press intensity as the half goes on, so Harbour's PPDA will rise.
Harbour will keep forcing turnovers high up to maintain danger, so Kestrel's central entries should fall.
Gregor Molina will sit a midfielder deeper to reduce Harbour's high wins, cutting Harbour high regains.
Kestrel will try to crowd Harbour's centre to blunt their central entries, lowering Harbour centre channel entries.
If they push more players higher to chase the game, Kestrel's possession share should increase.

result.text: Kestrel converted the tactical shift into goals by increasing final-third entries and xG in the second half while Harbour's threat subsided as their high regains and shots dropped.
Harbour's first-half dominance left them with a two-goal cushion (two first-half goals) but they couldn't fend off Kestrel's second-half comeback, and the match finished level.
Overall the match was decided by Kestrel's successful midfield adjustment and increased possession after the break, reversing the early territory and forcing a 2-2 draw.
